evals.prompt: Grill me on docs/payment-redesign.md. The repository can tell you which callers still use the old payment identifier, but I need to decide whether account ownership or invoice ownership controls the migration.
evals.expected_output: Should read instructions and the document, investigate callers itself, explain the current understanding, and ask one ownership decision with a recommendation. It should wait rather than editing or implementing immediately.
expectations: Investigates caller facts instead of asking the user
Provides a recommended answer and tradeoffs
Does not edit or implement before shared understanding

evals.prompt: Read this short deployment note and tell me which command it says to run. There is no design decision here.
evals.expected_output: Should answer the factual question directly and avoid initiating an unnecessary interview or creating artifacts.
expectations: Does not manufacture a decision interview

evals.prompt: Grill this rough modernization idea. It spans several sessions, has unknown migration boundaries, and this repository already uses Beads.
evals.expected_output: Should use the interview to settle the destination and visible frontier, then route the persistent map to beads-wayfinder rather than writing a large planning document.
expectations: Identifies the effort as multi-session fog
Uses Beads Wayfinder for durable mapping
Does not create a standalone Markdown plan
